fields.description: Issue includes extensive reporting alleging misconduct by psychiatrist Dr. Moore involving treatment of a young woman (Kay Katsufrakis), including pills/capsules, hypnosis, and attempted shock treatment, and references to Rev. Joseph Barth and related legal proceedings. Also includes local court coverage quoting Judge Curry on liquor-related offenses and other petty cases, a report on a downtown power blackout affecting the Dade County courthouse, nightlife and entertainment columns and advertisements, and a large classified business directory.
